extracted.intended_audience: researchers preparing NIH-style grant applications (PD/PI and Senior/Key Personnel)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and form fields for completing NIH-format Biographical Sketches (Senior/key personnel) and the Research & Related Budget (sections A–K) for a grant application. Covers required sections, page limits, required budget line items, and attachment rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each senior/key person's biosketch must follow the prescribed format and must not exceed four pages. Include all sections (A–D) for each person and keep to the four-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name, position title, eRA Commons user name, education/training block
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME POSITION TITLE eRA COMMONS USER NAME EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.) INSTITUTION AND LOCATION DEGREE (if applicable) MM/YY FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide institutional names/locations, degrees (if applicable), dates (MM/YY), and field of study in chronological order beginning with the baccalaureate. Include postdoctoral and residency training where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a concise personal statement describing the individual's main research focus, relevance of their expertise to the proposed project, key contributions and experience (e.g., discovery, methodology, model systems), and why the individual is well suited to their role on the project. Examples in the document illustrate describing decades-long focus, relevant discoveries, methods developed, and prior program leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors: list positions and employment with dates, and honors/awards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chronological list of academic and professional positions (with dates and institutions) and significant honors, editorial board memberships, invited lectures, awards, and leadership roles relevant to the applicant's qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Selected Peer-reviewed Publications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List selected peer-reviewed publications, emphasizing those most relevant to the current application (the examples show 'Selected (of total)' and 'Most relevant to the current application'). Provide citation details (authors, year, title, journal, volume:pages). Indicate selection from a larger body of work where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (current and recent)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support (ongoing or completed in past 3 years)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List current and recently completed research support with project period dates, project title, role (PI/Co-PI), organization/agency (e.g., NIH), and a brief statement of the project's aims. Distinguish current support from completed support and include major multi-year grants and foundation awards relevant to the investigator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: Section A & B — Senior/Key Person and Other Personnel fields
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - SECTION A & B, BUDGET PERIOD ... Project Role Base Salary ($) Fringe Benefits ($) Funds Requested ($) Number of Personnel Project Role Acad. Months Sum. Months Requested Salary ($) Cal. Months Post Doctoral Associates Graduate Students Undergraduate Students Secretarial/Clerical
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each budget period, provide for Senior/Key Persons and Other Personnel: names, project role, academic months, calendar months, requested salary, fringe benefits, and number of personnel in each category (postdocs, grad students, undergrads, clerical). Sum salaries and fringe benefits and list totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment listing requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment Description List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize each equipment purchase that exceeds $5,000 with description and funds requested. Provide a subtotal for equipment and include total funds requested for all listed equipment in the attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel costs line items
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel Domestic Travel Costs ( Incl. Canada, Mexico and U.S. Possessions) Foreign Travel Costs Total Travel Cost
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate domestic and foreign travel costs and provide totals for each. Include travel justifications in the budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Cost categories
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance Stipends Travel Subsistence Other Number of Participants/Trainees Total Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If participant or trainee support is requested, itemize tuition/fees/insurance, stipends, travel, subsistence, and other costs, and state the number of participants/trainees supported. Provide totals for participant/trainee support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs (F) — required line items
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs Materials and Supplies Publication Costs Consultant Services ADP/Computer Services Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees Alterations and Renovations ... Total Other Direct Costs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List and justify all other direct costs (materials, publications, consultants, ADP/computer services, subawards, rental/user fees, alterations, etc.). Provide totals for Section F and include required attachments (e.g., subaward budgets).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Direct Costs and Indirect Costs reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: G. Direct Costs Total Direct Costs (A thru F) H. Indirect Costs Indirect Cost Rate (%) Indirect Cost Base ($) Cognizant Federal Agency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the total of direct costs (Sections A–F). Specify the indirect (F&A) cost rate (percent), the base amount used to calculate indirects, and identify the cognizant federal agency for indirect cost negotiation. Include calculation details in the budget justification or attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Institutional Costs, Fee, and Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H) J. Fee K. * Budget Justification Indirect Cost Type Funds Requested ($) ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the grand totals (direct + indirect), any fee, and a detailed budget justification explaining and defending the requested costs and indirect cost calculations. Include any required breakdowns and narrative justification for major cost categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment rule for budget
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When uploading the budget attachment, attach only a single file (e.g., '1252-Budget.pdf') containing the required budget detail and supporting documents. Ensure the file includes contact info where requested (Agency Name, POC Name, and POC Phone Number) if applicable.
